properties.name: Regierungsviertel bounds — task-11 Friedrichstraße civic expansion
properties.description: Lobed polygon covering the complete task-10 area plus the Berliner Ensemble and Berlin Friedrichstraße station in the north-east. Europacity/DKB, Anhalter Bahnhof/Kochstraße and the complete Großer Tiergarten through Charlottenburger Tor remain inside the same bounded central-Berlin scene.
properties.source: Owner-approved task-11 scope, fitted to verified OpenStreetMap positions and official transport/civic sources checked in August 2026. The new north-east lobe follows the Spree and railway context tightly instead of taking an unbounded Mitte rectangle.
